name: @nb-multicore/plugin-lock-adapter-redis
description: Redis distributed locks (SET NX PX + Lua) so workflows, imports and schedulers never run twice across processes. Docs: https://github.com/rosaloverdue-dev/nocobase-multicore/tree/main/packages/plugin-lock-adapter-redis#readme

description.zh-CN: Redis 分布式锁（SET NX PX + Lua）：工作流、导入和计划任务不会在多个进程中重复执行。 文档：https://github.com/rosaloverdue-dev/nocobase-multicore/tree/main/packages/plugin-lock-adapter-redis#readme
